title: assessments/tutoring_provider_c.jsonl
description: One Tutoring Provider C assessment per line: a student's attempt at a set of multiple-choice questions, taken before or after a program or at the end of one session. Unique on (`assessment_type`, `program_id`, `session_id`), with `session_id` absent on program assessments.

source.description: The provider this assessment came from; matches the file name.

batch.description: Partner delivery this assessment came from. Provider C delivered once, so this is always `"2026-07-06"`.

assessment_type.description: When the assessment was taken: before the program (`pre_program`), at the end of one session (`post_session`), or after the program (`post_program`).

student_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the partner's student ID. Joins to `transcripts/tutoring_provider_c.jsonl` `session.student_id`.

program_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the program this assessment belongs to. Joins to `transcripts/tutoring_provider_c.jsonl` `session.program_id`. Pair assessments with sessions on this, not `student_id`: some students have more than one program, each with its own pre- and post-program assessment. Every program here has at least one transcript; assessments of programs whose sessions were all excluded from the transcripts do not ship.

session_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the session this assessment followed. Joins to `transcripts/tutoring_provider_c.jsonl` `session.session_id`. Present on `post_session` rows only. Every one names a session in the transcripts; exit cards of sessions excluded from the transcripts do not ship.

questions.description: The questions in this assessment. Empty means not attempted, not scored zero.

question_text.description: The question as authored, in HTML with MathML. Provider image URLs are replaced by `${TUTORING_PROVIDER_C_ASSETS_BASE_URL}` or `${TUTORING_PROVIDER_C_APP_BASE_URL}` placeholders; the images are not released. Some maths is an image from the third-party LaTeX renderer `latex.codecogs.com`, so rendering the HTML requests it there; each such image's `alt` attribute holds its LaTeX.

answers.description: The answer options offered for this question.

answer_id.description: Partner identifier of the option the student chose, matching an `answers[].id`. Null where the question was not answered.

is_correct.description: The partner's scoring of the student's choice. False on every unanswered question: use `answer_id` to tell wrong from unanswered.

lesson_id.description: Partner identifier for the learning objective the question assesses. Same ID space as `transcripts/tutoring_provider_c.jsonl` `session.lesson_plan[].learning_objective.id`.

assignment_date.description: Jittered date the assessment was assigned. The offset is constant per student, so intervals within a student are preserved; absolute dates and differences across students are not.

answer.description: The option as authored, in HTML.

given_answer.description: Whether the student chose this option. Null on every option of an unanswered question.

correct_answer.description: Whether this option is the correct one.
